claims: Gonzaga University is a private Jesuit university.
Gonzaga University is located in Spokane, Washington.
Gonzaga University's campus is situated along the Spokane River.
Gonzaga University's address is 502 East Boone Avenue, Spokane, Washington 99258.
Gonzaga University has an urban setting within the city of Spokane.
Spokane is the largest metropolitan area between Seattle and Minneapolis.
Gonzaga University includes the Bollier Center for Science & Engineering.
Gonzaga University includes the Myrtle Woldson Performing Arts Center
